Meta.title: WoWHelp
Meta.description: Plan your World of Warcraft sessions: pick what you want to do today, track your goals and see what data each answer comes from.

Footer.disclaimer: WoWHelp is a fan-made tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft and Blizzard Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.
Footer.status: Early preview. Features arrive in phases and each page says what is ready.
Footer.credits: Logo and illustrations by Elianai dos Santos (eliz00r).

gear.title: Improve my gear
gear.summary: Find the next upgrade worth chasing for your character.

mounts.title: Collect mounts
mounts.summary: Pick a mount you don't have yet and follow the steps to get it.

achievements.title: Track achievements
achievements.summary: Keep an eye on the achievements you care about.

weekly.title: Organize weekly tasks
weekly.summary: Know what resets this week and what is worth doing.

alts.title: Manage my alts
alts.summary: Spread goals across characters without repeating work.

class.title: Learn my class
class.summary: Understand your class and spec at your own pace.

sessions.title: Plan a play session
sessions.summary: Got 15, 30 or 60 minutes? Get a short list for that time.

housing.title: Collect housing decor
housing.summary: Track the decor you want for your home.

Home.metaTitle: What do you want to do today?
Home.heading: What do you want to do today?
Home.intro: Choose what you want from the game right now. WoWHelp turns it into goals and short steps you can follow on any screen, and tells you where each piece of data comes from.
Home.pickerLabel: Choose up to eight things you want to do
Home.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing chosen yet} one {# chosen} other {# chosen}}
Home.trackerEmpty: Choose something on the left and it shows up here, like a quest you just accepted.
Home.trackerEmptyMobile: Choose something above and it shows up here.

howSteps.choose: Choose what you want to do. You can change it whenever you like.
howSteps.connect: Bring in your characters: Battle.net linking and the Companion addon import arrive in later phases.
howSteps.plan: Follow goals and checklists made for the time you have.

Home.sourcesIntro: Every status on WoWHelp shows its source and when it was last checked. When we don't know something, we say so instead of guessing.

battlenet.title: Battle.net
battlenet.body: Characters and collections from Blizzard's official API, only with your permission.

addon.title: WoWHelp Companion addon
addon.body: Data the game lets addons read, saved on your computer. You upload the file yourself.

manual.title: You
manual.body: Goals, checklists and progress you mark yourself. Always labeled as entered by you.

Home.pickerHint: Choose as many as you like. You can change them later.

Availability.goalsMeanwhile: Until each tool arrives, you can already create goals and checklists for any of them below.

Auth.signInIntro: Use the e-mail and password of your WoWHelp account. This is not your Battle.net login.
Auth.signUpIntro: A WoWHelp account keeps your goals and checklists. You can link Battle.net later, separately.
Auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
Auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.
Auth.notConfigured: Accounts are not available in this environment yet: the database connection is not configured.

errors.user_already_exists: There is already an account with this e-mail. Sign in instead.
errors.weak_password: Choose a stronger password: at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.not_configured: Accounts are not available in this environment yet.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

Auth.confirmErrorBody: The link may have expired or was already used. Sign in, or create the account again to get a new link.

Mounts.title: Mount catalog
Mounts.intro: Every mount in World of Warcraft Retail, straight from Blizzard's official data. Search, filter and turn any mount into a goal.
Mounts.attribution: Mount data provided by Blizzard Entertainment and refreshed every week.
Mounts.reviewTitle: The official catalog is being imported
Mounts.reviewBody: The mount list comes from Blizzard's official API and is imported in batches. Come back in a few minutes.
Mounts.unavailable: The catalog can't be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.
Mounts.results: {count, plural, =0 {No mounts match these filters} one {# mount} other {# mounts}}
Mounts.noResults: Try another name or remove a filter.

statusHelp.unknown: Connect Battle.net, import the Companion addon or mark it yourself to know.

Mounts.signInForStatus: Sign in to see which mounts you already have.
Mounts.notFound: This mount is not in the catalog.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.languageBody: WoWHelp is available in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
Settings.regionBody: Used later to calculate resets and fetch your characters.
Settings.privacyBody: WoWHelp keeps your email, preferences, goals and whatever you connect or import. We use no analytics or advertising trackers.
Settings.installBody: Add WoWHelp to your home screen to open it like an app.
Settings.installIos: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
Settings.installDone: WoWHelp is installed on this device.
Settings.installUnsupported: Your browser doesn't offer installation here. Try Chrome or Edge on desktop or Android, or Safari on iPhone.

Offline.title: You're offline
Offline.body: WoWHelp needs a connection to load your goals. Your data stays safe on the server and nothing is stored on this device.

NotFound.title: This page doesn't exist
NotFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.body: The page failed to load. Try again, and if it keeps happening, come back later.

Characters.title: Characters
Characters.intro: Link your Battle.net account to bring in your characters and your mount collection. WoWHelp reads only what you authorize and never sees your password.
Characters.retention: Data from Battle.net is deleted automatically if it is not refreshed within 30 days, and right away when you disconnect.
Characters.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this region and delete the characters and collection that came from Battle.net? Your goals stay.
Characters.consent: You will be sent to Battle.net to approve access to your World of Warcraft characters and collections. Syncing again asks for approval again, because WoWHelp does not keep your Battle.net access.
Characters.notConfigured: Battle.net linking is not available in this environment yet.
Characters.mountsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No mounts found in the collection} one {# mount collected} other {# mounts collected}}
Characters.empty: No characters yet. Connect Battle.net to bring them in.
Characters.emptyRegion: No characters found in this region.

results.connected: Battle.net connected. Characters and mounts are up to date.
results.connected_partial: Characters synced, but the mount collection could not be read. It shows as unknown until the next sync.
results.denied: You declined the authorization on Battle.net. Nothing was changed.
results.expired: The connection took too long. Start again.
results.invalid_state: The connection could not be verified. Start again from this page.
results.session: Your WoWHelp session changed during the connection. Sign in and try again.
results.token: Battle.net did not accept the authorization. Try again in a moment.
results.profile: Battle.net did not return your characters. Try again later.
results.storage: We could not save the data. Try again.
results.not_configured: Battle.net linking is not available in this environment yet.

Characters.addonBody: The WoWHelp Companion addon saves your characters on your computer and you import the file here.

Planner.title: Planner
Planner.intro: Pick how much time you have. WoWHelp builds a short list from your weekly tasks and the next step of each active goal, in an order you can follow.
Planner.sessionLabel: How much time do you have?
Planner.plan: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing fits in this time yet} one {# item · about {minutes} min} other {# items · about {minutes} min}}
Planner.planEmpty: Add weekly tasks below or steps with an estimated time to your goals, and they show up here.
Planner.leftover: {count, plural, one {# more item did not fit} other {# more items did not fit}}
Planner.resetEstimated: Estimated time: Blizzard does not publish it for this region. Check in game.
Planner.tasksIntro: Things you do every week or every day. Marking one as done counts only until the next reset.

errors.invalid: Write a task between 1 and 120 characters.
errors.quota: You reached the limit of recurring tasks.
errors.unknown: We couldn’t save that. Try again.

Import.title: Import from the addon
Import.intro: Rather not connect Battle.net? The WoWHelp Companion addon saves your characters and mount collection on your computer, and you upload the file here.
Import.step1Body: Extract the zip into this folder:
Import.downloadNote: For World of Warcraft Retail (Midnight, interface {interface}). No internet access and no combat data.
Import.step2Body: The addon reads your data when you log in and when you earn a mount. Type /wowhelp to see the last read.
Import.step3Body: The game only writes the file to your computer when you log out or reload the UI.
Import.previewCharacters: {count, plural, =0 {No characters} one {# character} other {# characters}}
Import.previewMounts: {count, plural, =0 {No mounts collected} one {# mount collected} other {# mounts collected}}
Import.previewMountsUnknown: The addon couldn't read your mount collection. It stays unknown.
Import.alreadyImported: You already imported this exact file. Log in to the game again to create new data.
Import.replaceNote: Addon data replaces your previous import. Battle.net data and your own marks stay.
Import.successCharacters: {count, plural, one {# character updated} other {# characters updated}}
Import.successMounts: {count, plural, =0 {No mounts collected} one {# mount marked as collected} other {# mounts marked as collected}}

errors.too_large: The file is over 512 KB. Upload only WoWHelpCompanion.lua.
errors.syntax: We couldn't read the file. Make sure it's WoWHelpCompanion.lua from the SavedVariables folder.
errors.unsupported: The file contains code, and we only accept the file written by the game. Upload the original, unedited.
errors.too_deep: The file has an unexpected format. Upload the original written by the game.
errors.too_many: The file has too many items. Upload the original written by the game.
errors.string_too_long: The file has text that is too long. Upload the original written by the game.
errors.wrong_variable: This file belongs to another addon. Look for WoWHelpCompanion.lua.
errors.invalid_format: The file isn't in the WoWHelp Companion format. Update the addon and try again.
errors.unsupported_version: This file comes from an addon version the site doesn't know yet. Update the addon with the button above.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.empty: The file is empty. Log in to the game with the addon enabled and type /reload before uploading.
errors.invalid: We couldn't confirm the file. Upload it again.
errors.no_region: The file doesn't say your account region, so characters can't be saved. Import mounts only.
errors.not_configured: Import isn't available in this environment yet.
errors.storage: We couldn't save right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.read: Your browser couldn't open the file. Try again.
errors.rate_limited: You imported 30 files in the last 24 hours. Try again tomorrow.

Import.historyCharacters: {count, plural, =0 {no characters} one {# character} other {# characters}}
Import.historyMounts: {count, plural, =0 {no mounts} one {# mount} other {# mounts}}
Import.deleteBody: Removes the characters, collection and history that came from the addon. Battle.net data and your own marks stay.
Import.privacy: The file is read on our server without running anything and discarded right after. We keep only characters, collected mounts and a summary of each import, until you delete them here or delete your account.

Account.dataBody: Download a copy of everything WoWHelp keeps about you (profile, goals, planner, characters, collection and addon imports) as a JSON file.
Account.deleteBody: Deletes the account and all of its data right away: goals, planner, Battle.net connections, characters, collection and addon imports. This cannot be undone.
Account.deleteLabel: To confirm, type the account email

errors.mismatch: The email you typed isn't this account's email.
errors.failed: We couldn't delete it right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.not_configured: Account deletion isn't available in this environment yet.

Account.deletedBody: We deleted your account and all of its data. Thanks for trying WoWHelp.
